answer: Make sybilism pay per body, per epoch: every identity solves a unique, unguessable work puzzle each epoch - a tundra of separate trials where no solution transfers between agents or epochs. The fee f_e tracks median honest latency via a difficulty oracle, so n clones cost n*f_e every epoch, strictly linear in fleet size. Each solution commits to the identity's vertex in the interaction graph, resettable only by burning all reputation. Honest agents stay lotus-quiet: one puzzle, one attestation, normal earnings; outsourcing voids payouts, provable on-chain.
